decision_rationale: The record presents a new named model, BIOREASON, that integrates a DNA foundation model with an LLM and is evaluated on genomic reasoning tasks. The provided dataset description and discussion show central DNA-to-text reasoning and step-by-step generated explanations, not a wrapper around an existing model.
evidence_snippet: "deeply integrates a DNA foundation model with a large language model (LLM)"; "Input: paired reference and variant DNA sequences ... and a textual query"; "generate step-by-step reasoning"; "direct LLM reasoning on genomic data"; "sequence-to-sequence generation of Y OUT containing step-by-step reasoning"; "transparent, stepwise explanations"
